### 1. `metasystem/cmd/metasystem/intent_delivery.go` — `runIntentReview`

Main (`git log --oneline 2f4fa5e3b..origin/main -- PATH`):
- `382dc9431` lane-first-run-fixes u5b: the landing agent resolves a merge conflict as the seat
- `d0f54ef6a` lane-first-run-fixes u5c: the engine lets the landing agent build, commit and read a fix on its batch tree
- `00c297678` merge of 382dc9431 into fix/round-2b

Main's intent: `runIntentReview` first routes a lane merge/fix read through
`laneMergeWork(inv)` (`if code, handled := laneMergeWork(inv); handled { return code }`).

Goal (`git log --oneline 2f4fa5e3b..625ec7bc7 -- PATH`):
- `f50d1a8e6` U2a, `4d40a88f5` U2b, `1357eb33d` U3

Goal's intent: `runIntentReview` refuses `--act`/`--check` unless the call is an exact retained
subject check (`--commit`, `--goal`, `--check-only`), with the remedy
`work review --commit SHA --goal G --check-only`.

Expected resolution: keep both statements. Keep main's `laneMergeWork` route and the goal's
refusal; decide the order by reading `laneMergeWork` so a lane merge/fix read
(`work review GOAL --work lane-merge-1` / `lane-fix-1`) still reaches its route and the goal's
refusal still guards every other `--act`/`--check` call.

### 2. `metasystem/cmd/metasystem/intent_unit_check.go` — `resolveUnitCheck`

Main (`git log --oneline 2f4fa5e3b..origin/main -- PATH`):
- `d0f54ef6a` lane-first-run-fixes u5c (lane fix build on the batch tree)
- `80e34aad8` lane-proves-at-the-batch-risk U2 (the batch's depth; the resolution job's and fix round's checks follow the same rule; collection reuses the job's recorded check when staged tree and base are unchanged)

Main's version of `resolveUnitCheck` has three branches:
1. `laneCheck`: when `inv.connection().laneFix(installRoot, plan.Worktree, plan.Goal) != nil`
   and `--check` is exactly `metasystem test impact`, the check is
   `metasystem test impact --check`, audits `true`, 15 minutes, and the build brief is
   prefixed with `Stage the repair before running its check.\n`.
2. A manual `--check`: the actor must be a human (`inv.actingAs("work build manual check", plan.Goal, actorHuman)`),
   `SelectedBy` is `unitStopActor(actor)`, `--reason` is required
   ("a manual check needs --reason TEXT --by NAME before --check"), and the override is recorded
   with `inv.recordUnitStopOverride(plan.Goal, "work-build-check", ...)`.
3. Otherwise: the check is read from the worktree's committed `proof.cheap`, `proof.audits`,
   `proof.deadline` through `landingProofCommand` (with `check.SourceTree` set).
   `check.Environment` is `os.Environ()`.

Goal (`git log --oneline 2f4fa5e3b..625ec7bc7 -- PATH`):
- `5c4a404b4` U0, `f50d1a8e6` U2a, `4d40a88f5` U2b, `f1b871532` U4,
  `625ec7bc7` Keep check questions in the installation and repair integration fixtures

Goal's intent: process changes cover declarations and interventions. `resolveUnitCheck` first
calls `inv.selectLayoutRoot()`; a retained declared plan (`plan.Check.Declaration` with
`plan.Path == directory/plan.json`) is re-admitted through `inv.admitUnitDeclaration`; a
`--check` is admitted through the admission owner `inv.admitProcessCheck(plan, directory, check)`
(carry admission and the exact full-suite exception; `plan.FullArgv = check.FullArgv`); with no
`--check`, the check comes from `inv.admitUnitDeclaration(&plan, directory, publish)` then
`admitProcessCheck`; the brief and `plan.json` are written by `publish`.
`check.Environment` is `plan.Proof[0].Env`. The goal removed main's base-side
`landingProofCommand`/`recordUnitStopOverride` path because the declaration and admission owner
now supply it.

Expected resolution: the goal's structure (selectLayoutRoot, declaration re-admission,
admission owner, publish of brief and plan.json) plus main's lane fix check: the `laneCheck`
branch must still select `metasystem test impact --check` / `true` / 15 for the landing agent's
fix and merge-resolution builds, and still prefix the brief with
`Stage the repair before running its check.\n` (written through `publish`). Make sure a lane
check does not get refused by the goal's admission owner or the human-actor gate, since the landing
agent builds `--check 'metasystem test impact'` as a lane fix/merge. Keep main's human-actor
requirement and `--reason` requirement for a manual `--check` unless the goal's
`admitProcessCheck` already enforces the same thing (read it; if it does, keep the goal's
route and do not enforce twice). Keep imports consistent (`slices`, `os`, `strconv`, `strings`
only if used). Do not lose main's U2 behaviour in other files that call into this
(`80e34aad8` also touched the check reuse on collection).
